- 1.6.0: 3,119 keys. 1.6.1: 3,119 keys.

## Every value that moves

The coordinator's ruling of 19 Nov 2026 on 1.6.0's judgement 6, under ADR 0264 (Richard's rule: a missing expense is added; nothing counted twice): the new line's balancing part is the generators' share of the whole BSUoS charge above the gas-led alternative, switch-off payments and turn-up included, since the model's balancing lines take that whole share off and count it nowhere else. Against 1.5.0 the same keys move as in 1.6.0, now with 1.6.1's values: the VAT line, the indirect layer and all lines each year 2002-2025 and in the headline, the headline's modelled and estimated parts, share of the bill, every per-household and own-bills figure, the headline's range and counting options, and the bridge with Report No. 1. Against 1.6.0 only the line's balancing part (2002-2023), the line, its range, the bridge step and what holds them move.
